label: Some accessible world lacks every concrete being CONTINGENCY_1 at w
paraphrase: OPEN (P4-prime, Pruss's possibility premise; analyst reconstruction): some world accessible from w lacks every concrete being that is contingent at w (MODAL_CONTINGENCY_1 at the actual world); other concrete beings, contingent or not, may exist there. Weaker than the global premise that possibly no concrete being is contingent (0dc833c1): with Euclidean access the global premise implies it, not conversely (controls). It does not follow from the contingency of each actual concretum taken singly (controls: two actual contingents, each possibly absent, never jointly absent).
